definitions.rates: Counts divided by all issued eligible requests whose native deadlines matured in that probe.
definitions.strict: Completed successfully with no rejected action while active before success; idle mistakes are separate.
definitions.ordinary: Successful completion regardless of prior rejected active actions.
definitions.translation_correct: Predicted target at the issuing command, on the same matured eligible denominator.
definitions.equal_seed_mean: Arithmetic mean of the three per-seed rates; null if any seed denominator is zero.
definitions.pooled: Sum of counts across seeds, with its own count-weighted ratio; not the reported equal-seed mean.
definitions.first_groups: First eligible request within this prospective probe for each actor/family/raw; pooled across its two jobs. It may follow other A feedback and is not a no-A-feedback test.
definitions.idle: Non-WAIT actions per 1,000 actual idle job opportunities.
definitions.gates: Observed learned/provided gates only; success and command categories may overlap.
definitions.prospective: Each probe contains newly issued requests; different probe ticks are not the same request cohort.
definitions.interventions: Clear-M/clear-z are one-time interventions followed by normal state updates; no-read uses uniform payload probabilities.

comparability.manual_native_note: Manual hard/soft reuse a different historical training budget and parameterization from native; do not infer an equal-training causal comparison.
comparability.native_branch_note: Native frozen/PG share support endpoint and B interaction budget; their actions and receipts can subsequently differ.
comparability.teacher_note: Teacher-supported probes are a separate diagnostic, never pooled with the own-action main line.

B_learning_curves.normalization: First normalize each block by 512 ticks * 32 actors; average eight consecutive blocks. Both jobs contribute to actor reward.
